title: How to Turn on LinkedIn Creator Mode
description:
If you see a LinkedIn profile that has hashtags below the headline, that means that that person's turned on LinkedIn Creator Mode. It's a setting for members who regularly create content on the platform, and you can choose up to five topics that you want to talk about. If you have Creator Mode turned on, the call to action button will show up as "Follow" instead of "Connect."

Here's how to turn it on. On the top, right. Go to the "Me" section and then "View Profile." Scroll down until you see creator mode there you can type in up to five topics that you want to talk about regularly. 

Some creators will also have the option to see additional tools, such as LinkedIn Live or newsletter creation.
